responses.text: My request is perfectly reasonable. Give us the Stealth Boy specs and there will be no need for us to splatter the room with your insides.

topics.prompt: Do you have a problem with humans?

responses.text: It is different! Right now I'm trying very hard to remain civil, and you're not making it easy with your incessant questions!
